title: A prospective randomized single blind multicenter phase II study of organ perfusion with Custodiol-N compared with Custodiol in heart transplantation in children (CL-N-HTX-Paed-II/10/20)
official: A prospective randomized single blind multicenter phase II study of organ perfusion with Custodiol-N compared with Custodiol in heart transplantation in children (CL-N-HTX-Paed-II/10/20)
summary:
Main objective: The objective of this investigation is to compare the safety of two organ preservation solutions,Custodiol and Custodiol-N, in paediatric patients undergoing heart transplantation
Primary: Safety assessment, i.e. continuous adverse event reporting up to 3 months
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patient criteria: Age from birth to less than18 years
2. Patient critera: Recipients awaiting their first transplant
3. Patient criteria: Ability of the patients and/ or their legal guardians to understand character and individual consequences of the clinical trial
4. Patient criteria: written informed consent of the patients and/ or their legal guardians (must be available before enrolment in the study)
5. Patient criteria: Patient listed on the waiting list for heart transplantation
6. Donor criteria: deceased donors should fulfil the standard criteria for organ donation (SCD)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients who have participated within 30 days or are still participating in any other interventional studies
2. history of severe organic disease other than concerning the heart
3. history/demonstration of HIV antibodies or AIDS
4. multiorgan transplantation
5. machine-perfused organ
6. the explantation team is affiliated to another clinic than transplantation team
7. Failing Fontan patients
8. Pregnancy and lactation
9. Patients who have been incarcerated or involuntarily institutionalized by court order or by the authorities
